## Problem

Describe the concrete problem and link the related issue or discussion.

## Change

Explain the resulting behavior, scope, and important tradeoffs.

## Validation

List the commands, tests, or other checks run and their results.

## Compatibility and provenance

Describe effects on stored bytes, identities, source references, formats, public
APIs, or project-state semantics. State explicitly if none are affected.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change follows the project principles and has a bounded scope.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass, and behavior changes have regression tests.
- [ ] Documentation matches implemented behavior; future work is identified as such.
- [ ] No real conversation exports, credentials, or private project data are included.
- [ ] Third-party material and dependencies are identified and justified, if any.
